cases.title: The notes can't be read: one sentence about it, then a first lesson, nothing said before the snapshot

rubric.reason: Nothing was said before the snapshot call; the reply then opens with the tool's plain-words message ("I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons..."), says it only once with no file, field or error code, and goes on with first-lesson behavior on Mentor Practice 2 (the easing prerequisite offer) instead of stopping.
The only names the mentor uses are "Mentor Practice 2" and easing, which match the snapshot's comp.name and other_skills; no layer, property or time is invented.
The mentor says "I have nothing showing you've done that one" and offers easing as a choice, which is the allowed 'nothing marked' wording; it never claims the learner hasn't learned easing.

After the snapshot (nothing said before it), the mentor says once, in plain words, "I couldn't read my notes from your earlier lessons...", then opens the lesson as a learner with no history by offering easing first or going on with this one; it names no file, field or error code.
The mentor names no layer, property or time; it only mentions easing and `/ease-mentor`, and both are backed by the snapshot's other_skills entry for Easing.
The mentor says only that "easing isn't marked as learned yet", which describes what is marked, as the rubric allows, and never says the learner hasn't done it.
